title: Formatting a total
description: format_total(prices) should add up a list of prices and return a label such as 'Total: 7.5'. An empty list gives 'Total: 0'.

bug.summary: The function joins a string and a number with +, which raises TypeError.

hints.1: Python is strict about combining text and numbers. Read the error message and think about the types of the two values being joined.
hints.2: Look at the return statement on line {line}, where "Total: " and `total` are joined with +. What type is each side?
hints.3: `+` between a string and a number raises TypeError, because Python won't guess how to join them. The number has to become text before it is added to the label.
